abdomenatlas-ct-iso1p5.title: Abdominal organs (CT, AbdomenAtlas 1.0), 1.5 mm
abdomenatlas-ct-iso1p5.description: SlimFormer++ with window self-attention in encoder 1 on 1.5 mm isotropic voxels (patch 128^3, level-0 kernel 3x3x3, first stride 2x2x2), trained with nnU-Net v2 on the 5,195 CT scans of AbdomenAtlas 1.0 (public release): SlimFormer++ for 1000 epochs at 2.5 x 0.81 x 0.81 mm, the encoder-1 attention variant for 200 epochs, then 200 epochs at 1.5 mm. 9 abdominal organs, per-image z-score intensity normalisation. Mean Dice 85.09 / NSD 83.05 on 743 TotalSegmentator v2.0.1 CT scans (Touchstone 743 subset, test-time augmentation, sliding-window step 0.5).

abdomenatlas-ct-iso3p0.title: Abdominal organs (CT, AbdomenAtlas 1.0), 3 mm
abdomenatlas-ct-iso3p0.description: SlimFormer++ with window self-attention in encoder 1 on 3 mm isotropic voxels (patch 128^3, level-0 kernel 3x3x3, first stride 2x2x2), trained with nnU-Net v2 on the 5,195 CT scans of AbdomenAtlas 1.0 (public release): SlimFormer++ for 1000 epochs at 2.5 x 0.81 x 0.81 mm, the encoder-1 attention variant for 200 epochs, then 1200 epochs at 3 mm. 9 abdominal organs, per-image z-score intensity normalisation. Mean Dice 78.18 / NSD 75.76 on 743 TotalSegmentator v2.0.1 CT scans (Touchstone 743 subset, test-time augmentation, sliding-window step 0.5); below the 1.5 mm model mostly on scans that show only part of the abdomen.
